title: FIG. 05 · Phase track, handed over
summary: The round-2 phase gantt you approved, back in the same heading and framed panel as the rest of the page and now full: each phase with what it delivers, the ten-day audit as the one red bar, a Handover line, and your Calibrate line running out of the panel and off the page.
story: Having just shown the exit (the system stays when we leave), this section shows the entry and the whole engagement on one line: the audit lit red at the start, the three build phases on Kelwin's side, the handover, then a line that is yours and never stops. It hands "the audit" to the next section, which opens with "The audit is a gate".
motion: Entrance, standalone: the heading plays the way it does in every other section. The label fades in, "It starts with" and "the audit." rise into place, the short red rule draws, and the intro and the note fade up. The panel rises at 0.4s. The ruler draws left to right, the ten audit ticks arrive slightly off-pitch and settle onto the scale, the column dividers draw down, and the ruler break, the phase marks and the title block appear.

The phases then build in reading order. Diagnose's column brightens and its red bar extends (from 1.3s). As it does, the ten ticks above it light one by one and its label counts 01 → 10 working days. Under the three build phases, the "Kelwin's side" line draws along the bottom. Architect follows (2.0s), then Install (2.7s).

The Handover line draws up from the bottom line, through the panel and just past its top edge (3.35s), and its tag appears. Calibrate's column brightens and its white bar runs out from the Handover line, through the panel edge and off the page (3.85–4.85s), together with the "Yours" line. The dashed retainer line and its label fade in at 4.5s. Everything has landed by about 5.1s.

Ambient, the page's only loop besides the hero film: a small dark square rides the Calibrate bar from the Handover line off the page, one lap every 9.6 seconds, at a steady pace. It pauses while the section is off screen.
Interaction: hovering a phase dims the text of the other three, so one phase can be read on its own. There is nothing to click, no tabs and no toggle.

On the live page: the heading plays as the section arrives. The panel holds on its first frame until about a third of it is in view, then plays once. There is no pin and no scroll scrubbing, and scrolling back does not replay it. Reduced motion: the finished drawing appears at once, with no moving square and no timers.
addressed: "It seems a little too empty": the panel is now full from edge to edge. Each phase shows its name and its output (what you get from it). Under the ruler sit the four bars, the audit measured as ten working days, the Handover line, a dashed retainer line, your Calibrate line, and a bottom line that says whose side each part is on. The big open corners from round 3 are gone.

"An abrupt change in design language": it is back in the family. It uses the same heading as the reframe and the stack (red-square label, two-line heading, short red rule, intro, note at right) and the same framed panel, ruler and title block as the other drawings.
It starts from the round-2 gantt you approved: four phase columns sit over the bars, each bar sits under its own phase, and the build plays left to right in reading order.
It is not a copy of the reframe: there is no caption strip and no toggle at the bottom of the panel. The panel ends on the ownership line instead (Kelwin's side, then Handover, then Yours).

"Sells and deploys revenue architecture as a service" is now visible in one glance. Diagnose, Architect and Install sit on Kelwin's side. The Handover line follows. Calibrate is yours and runs off the edge of the page. A dashed line marked "With us on retainer" shows that we can stay on to run it. That is the note "Install first, then an operating retainer — on a system you own", drawn.
The audit is the only red and the only measured span: ten ticks sit over its bar, then the ruler breaks. Everything after the break is marked Indicative, so no durations are invented.
notes: Builder notes. Composition: X's head grammar (kit .ac-head: label, 88px two-voice statement 'It starts with' / 'the audit.' with the accent on line 2, a 48×2 rule, the lede in cols 1–6 with text-wrap: pretty, and the note in cols 10–12 bottom-aligned), then one .ac-plate 1312×476 with no caption band. The plate is set to overflow: visible on purpose so that Calibrate and the retainer line leave through its right edge; the section root uses overflow-x: clip, which keeps the lint clean. Geometry (plate px): four 328px bays, with text and bars at bay + 32. The column zone runs 0–252 (bay dividers stop at the ruler, so the Handover datum at x 984 is the gantt's only vertical). The ruler is at y 252: eleven ticks at a 22px pitch over the Diagnose bar (32 → 252, majors at 0/5/10 working days), a two-slash axis break at 271–288, then a plain indicative hairline with phase-gate ticks at 360 and 688. Bars are 10px with tops at 284 / 320 / 356 / 392. Diagnose 32→252 (red), Architect 360→640, Install 688→968, Calibrate 984→off the page (paper). The build bars use --fg-3 over an opaque --panel ground, so lane guides don't show through. The retainer is a 10px dashed stroke (16 8, --line-2) in Install's lane from 1000 to off the page, over an occluder inside the plate. The ownership axis is at y 436: 'Kelwin's side' knocked out of the left line, the boxed 'Handover' tag centred on the datum, then 'Yours' and a line off the page. The datum rises from the tag to 16px above the plate with a 12px cap, echoing the round-2 handover datum. The title block (Fig. 05 · Phase track · Indicative) sits between lane guides in the gantt's lower-left. Copy sources, nothing new: the statement, lede, phase names, outputs, '10 working days · the System Audit', Handover and Yours are round-3 method S, verbatim. 'Engagements' and 'Install first, then an operating retainer — on a system you own.' are FirmAbout's registry key and value. 'Kelwin's side' comes from handover S / assets X. 'With us on retainer' is a fragment of the agreed Calibrate output. 'Output' is the field name from Methodology.tsx. ★ lines: 'It starts with the audit.' is kept verbatim as a two-voice head, and no ★ line changed. Title block says 'Indicative' rather than 'Specimen': the drawing is the real method with indicative timing, not a fabricated artifact (the same honesty label round 2 X and round 3 S used). Red: the label squares and the 48×2 rule (family), plus the Diagnose bar as the one red moment. There is no door; the ask comes two sections later (STORY). Quotas: 1 drawing, 1 title block (3 cells), 18 annotation words, and every mono string is one line of ≤ 34 characters. Motion is CSS under .is-play. JS only counts the audit label (started on the red bar's own animationstart, so it stays in sync when the homepage holds the plate), gates the plate on the homepage (data-wait pauses every body animation until the plate is 35% in view), and pauses the packet off screen (data-idle). Mobile (≤760px): --margin 16px. The phases stack as one column, each with its own bar. Handover becomes a full-width rule with its label between 03 and 04. Calibrate's bar and 'Yours' run off the right edge, the title block closes the panel, the drawing SVG and the 'Kelwin's side' / retainer labels are visibility-hidden (not display:none), and nothing changes animation-name inside the media query, because the capture briefly applies it and a changed animation-name restarts that element's entrance (that is what hid the Handover tag in the first build). Checked at 390px: no horizontal scroll. Stage height 1186px. Page context (handover S, method V, fit S): no console errors; the plate holds until in view, then builds.
